children: Customer experience tech firm's Q3 revenue declined over 5% yr/yr but beat analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company cites margin improvement and cost actions as drivers of profitability
TTEC sees full-year 2026 revenue between $1.94 bln and $1.99 bln
Company expects 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $0.79 to $0.99
Company expects higher margins in Q4 2026 for both Engage and Digital segments
FOREIGN EXCHANGE IMPACT - Co said foreign exchange negatively affected revenue by $2.1 mln in Q3
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT -  Margin gains in Engage segment were driven by cost management, program rationalization and operational efficiencies
DIGITAL SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said TTEC Digital saw double-digit expansion in growth practices
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for TTEC Holdings Inc (Texas) is $3.00, about 117.4% above its November 6 closing price of $1.38
